prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A close-up, high-resolution photograph of a luxury white leather handbag, focusing on the center of the bag where the brand name "EMPORIO ARMANI MILANO 1981" is embossed in elegant gold lettering. The leather has a fine, pebbled texture, and the stitching is precise and clean, emphasizing the craftsmanship. The upper corners of the image reveal two gold metal hinges or clasps, adding a touch of sophistication and contrast to the predominantly white surface. The lighting is soft and diffused, highlighting the texture of the leather and the subtle sheen of the gold hardware without creating harsh shadows. The composition is minimalist and symmetrical, with the brand name perfectly centered, evoking a sense of luxury, refinement, and modern elegance. The overall style is clean and editorial, suitable for a high-end fashion advertisement or product showcase.
